Review the September CH-01 monitoring evidence in Meadow_View_Chiller_Monitoring_2025-09.csv, the relevant maintenance history in Meadow_View_Refrigeration_Service_History_2025.csv, the factor analysis in Meadow_View_Cold_Storage_Root_Cause_Analysis.xlsx, and the issued nonconformance report.
